"# Implementation Plan - Franchise Page Magnifying Glass Upgrades

Upgrade the magnifying glass functionality on the Franchise Proposal Page ([FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx)).

## Proposed Changes

We will implement a global webpage magnifier by cloning the page content dynamically and scaling it inside a floating cursor-following lens. To prevent double-zooming, we will replace the localized `ImageMagnifier` components inside the sections with standard images, since the global magnifier will now handle magnifying the entire page.

### Franchise Page Upgrade

#### [MODIFY] [FranchisePageClient.tsx](file:///d:/anti-gv/25. 120pie(new)_2/app/franchise/FranchisePageClient.tsx)

1. **New States for Global Magnifier**:
   - `isMagnifierActive` (boolean): Controls whether the magnifying glass is active on the page. Defaults to `true`.
   - `lensPos` (`{ x: number, y: number }`): Stores the current coordinates of the lens.
   - `isHoveringClose` (boolean): Set to `true` when the mouse enters the close button, which freezes the lens position in place.
   - `pageHtml` (string): Stores the dynamic HTML of the page to mirror inside the lens.
   - `pageSize` (`{ width: number, height: number }`): Tracks the current page dimensions.

2. **Synchronized Content Mirroring**:
   - Wrap the entire page contents (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`) in a single container: `<div id="magnifiable-page">`.
   - In a `useEffect` hooked to `theme`, `selectedPlanTab`, and `activeMenuTab`, query the `innerHTML`, `offsetWidth`, and `offsetHeight` of `#magnifiable-page` to sync the mirrored page inside the lens.
   - Add a window resize listener to update the page width and height dynamically.
